Data Analyst (m/f/d)

Example Company is looking for a motivated Data Analyst to join our growing analytics team in Munich. In this role, you will work closely with stakeholders across the business to turn raw data into actionable insights that drive decision-making.

What you bring

You have a degree in a quantitative field such as statistics, computer science, mathematics, or economics. You are proficient in SQL and have hands-on experience with Python for data analysis, including libraries such as pandas and numpy. You are familiar with data visualization tools such as Power BI or Tableau, and you have a solid understanding of statistical methods. Fluent English is required; German is a plus.

What you will do

You will design and maintain dashboards that track key business metrics, perform exploratory data analysis to uncover trends and opportunities, collaborate with data engineers to improve our data infrastructure, and present findings to non-technical stakeholders in a clear and compelling way. You will also help define data quality standards and contribute to a culture of data-driven decision-making across the organization.

What we offer

We offer flexible working hours, the option to work from home two days a week, a modern office in central Munich, and a supportive team culture that values continuous learning. You will have access to a training budget and the opportunity to attend industry conferences.

Interested? Apply today and become part of our analytics team, where your insights will directly shape how we grow the business.
